name: neotoma
description: Neotoma for Claude: a bundled MCP connector (Claude Code: your Neotoma MCP URL setting, default the shared public sandbox; Cowork: the public sandbox; Chat ignores it, add a custom connector), onboarding skills (setup, check, recover), starter commands, and Claude Code lifecycle hooks that follow the same Neotoma. The same package also ships a Cursor hook map (.cursor/hooks.json -> cursor-hooks).

neotoma_mcp_url.title: Neotoma MCP URL
neotoma_mcp_url.description: The /mcp URL of the Neotoma the connector and hooks use, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3080/mcp or https://your-neotoma.example/mcp. Default: the shared public sandbox (visible to others and wiped; hooks never capture there). `neotoma hooks install --tool claude-code` sets this for you.
